pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal to stellate geometries with soft, low-contrast pixel gradients at the perimeters. The dark regions vary in spatial area, displaying jagged edges that blend into the corridor network.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-toned negative space. Pathways exhibit inconsistent pixel thickness, narrowing significantly at junction nodes and widening along the lateral flank segments.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the upper neck and shoulder transition, representing the pixel-level contour of the mane against the blurred background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized area of textural disruption and darkened, hyper-pigmented pixel clusters present on the upper-mid dorsal flank, contrasting with the surrounding smooth pelage.
